mushokucraft.config.mana_display_mode.to:
Mana display mode:
CLASSIC — Bar above the hotbar (classic RPG style)
DYNAMIC — Arc near crosshair (clean combat HUD)
HYBRID — Both (arc for real-time, bar for stats)
MINIMAL — Hidden until mana changes

spell.mushokucraft.water_slice.incantati: O great grace of water, condense and become the sharpest blade to cleave my foes! Water Slice!
spell.mushokucraft.icicle_break.incantat: O great grace of water, freeze into sharp fangs and rain down upon my enemies! Icicle Break!
spell.mushokucraft.cumulonimbus.incantat:
Oh, spirits of the magnificent waters,
I beseech the Prince of Thunder!
Grant me my wish, bless me with thy savagery,
and reveal to this insignificant servant a glimpse of thy power!
Let fear strike the heart of man as thy divine hammer strikes its anvil
and the torrential rains cover the land!
Oh, rain! Destroy and wash away everything!
CUMULONIMBUS!

magic_circle.mushokucraft.capture.desc: Ancient runic soul trap that drains life force from entrapped creatures and seals their essence into a manuscript.
magic_circle.mushokucraft.summoning.desc: High magic summoning circle allowing a sealed creature to be materialized as a loyal familiar.
